translationRepairs: In the fourteenth year of Guangxu (1888), when the river works were finished, nearly ten thousand laborers were dismissed. Misled by agitators, they gathered in a clamor at Zhuxian town.
In the fourteenth year of Guangxu (1888), when the river works were finished, several tens of thousands of laborers were dismissed. Misled by agitators, they gathered in a clamor at Zhuxian town.
數万 means several tens of thousands.
In the fourteenth year of Guangxu, when river works were completed, nearly tens of thousands of laborers were dismissed; deluded by troublemakers they gathered clamoring at Zhuxian town.
In the fourteenth year of Guangxu, when river works were completed, nearly several tens of thousands of laborers were dismissed; deluded by troublemakers they gathered clamoring at Zhuxian town.
近數万 means close to several tens of thousands.
Previously Miao militia trainer Pei Lin had spanned the Long Huai; after he submitted tribute to the Taiping and Nian he massacred militia who disagreed with him, and the militia groups submitted.
Previously Miao militia trainer Peilin had spanned the Long Huai; after he submitted tribute to the Taiping and Nian he massacred militia who disagreed with him, and the militia groups submitted.
苗沛霖's personal name Peilin should not be split.
Only Nanhua resisted, eliminated his faction; Pei Lin was enraged and sent Zhang Jianyou and others to besiege Meng.
Only Nanhua resisted, eliminated his faction; Peilin was enraged and sent Zhang Jianyou and others to besiege Meng.
苗沛霖's personal name Peilin should not be split.
Pei Lin dug deep trenches and long moats planning to wear them down over time.
Peilin dug deep trenches and long moats planning to wear them down over time.
苗沛霖's personal name Peilin should not be split.
During Pei Lin's rebellion he often fought in the fiercest places.
During Peilin's rebellion he often fought in the fiercest places.
苗沛霖's personal name Peilin should not be split.
When the Tongzhi reign began he pacified the country north of the Sui River.
When the Tongzhi reign began he pacified the country north of the Hui River.
澮北 refers to the Hui (Kuai) River, not the Sui.
At the change to Tongzhi he pacified north Sui.
At the change to Tongzhi he pacified north of the Hui.
澮北 refers to the Hui (Kuai) River, not the Sui.
His elder brother's son Zi Desheng helped manage the local militia and also served with considerable energy.
His elder brother's son Desheng helped manage the local militia and also served with considerable energy.
兄子得勝 means elder brother's son Desheng; 子 is not a surname.
He moved his troops to Jiangning, suppressed the local bandit Huo Zhihui's rebellion, and returned to Bozhou.
He moved his troops to Jiangning, suppressed the local bandit Hu Zhirui's rebellion, and returned to Bozhou.
胡志瑞 reads Hu Zhirui, not Huo Zhihui.
Moving troops to Jiangning he pacified the local bandit Huo Zhihui rebellion and returned to Bozhou.
Moving troops to Jiangning he pacified the local bandit Hu Zhirui rebellion and returned to Bozhou.
胡志瑞 reads Hu Zhirui, not Huo Zhihui.
In the spring of the first year of Tongzhi (1862) Li Hongzhang raised an army at Shanghai. Lügao served under him and took part in relieving Beixinjing and Sikou.
In the spring of the first year of Tongzhi (1862) Li Hongzhang raised an army at Shanghai. Lügao served under him and took part in relieving Beixinjing and Sijiangkou.
四江口 is Sijiangkou; the jiang syllable was dropped.
In the first spring month of Tongzhi's first year Li Hongzhang assembled an army at Shanghai; Lügao served under him and followed relief of Beixinjing and Sikou.
In the spring of Tongzhi's first year Li Hongzhang assembled an army at Shanghai; Lügao served under him and followed relief of Beixinjing and Sijiangkou.
四江口 is Sijiangkou; the jiang syllable was dropped. 元年春 means spring of the first year, not a month.
In the third year of Guangxu Muslim horse bandits rose on the Mongolian grasslands; he moved troops to defend Guihua and Baotou.
In the third year of Guangxu horse bandits rose on the Mongolian grasslands; he moved troops to defend Guihua and Baotou.
The source 馬賊 says horse bandits; nothing indicates Muslims.
When the rebels stole across the Hutuo River, Quansheng pursued and nearly wiped out the division of the false Huaiking Qiu Decai.
When the rebels stole across the Hutuo River, Quansheng pursued and nearly wiped out the division of the false Prince Huai, Qiu Decai,.
偽懷王 is the Taiping-style title Prince Huai; Huaiking is not a name.
The bandits secretly crossed the Hutuo River; Quansheng pursued and nearly destroyed the false Huaiking Qiu Decai's division.
The bandits secretly crossed the Hutuo River; Quansheng pursued and nearly destroyed the false Prince Huai, Qiu Decai,'s division.
偽懷王 is the Taiping-style title Prince Huai; Huaiking is not a name.
Attacking Wuxi, Quansheng led dare-to-die men as army vanguard, captured the false Chaowang Huang Zilong, and the city was taken.
Attacking Wuxi, Quansheng led dare-to-die men as army vanguard, captured the false Prince Chao Huang Zilong, and the city was taken.
偽潮王 is the title Prince Chao, better rendered in English.
Soon Lan Changchun was killed in an ambush and the rest were pacified.
Soon Lan Changchun was executed and the rest were pacified.
伏誅 means was executed, not killed in an ambush.
Soon the Lan rebel was executed in ambush and the remainder were all pacified.
Soon the Lan rebel was executed and the remainder were all pacified.
伏誅 means was executed; there was no ambush.

By the time the bandits realized and galloped to intercept, it was too late; the Zhang chieftain was executed in pairs; at the time Shihan was barely twenty and was twice promoted to raiding commander.

By the time the bandits realized and galloped to intercept, it was too late; the Zhang chieftain was executed together; at the time Shihan was barely twenty and was twice promoted to raiding commander.
駢誅 means executed together with others.
Mengcheng had long been besieged; the troops had no cash grain and the city nearly fell.
Mengcheng had long been besieged; the troops had no grain on hand and the city nearly fell.
現糧 means grain on hand, not cash grain.
In the twenty-first year Muslim rebels stirred in the Huang and Tao river region; Shihan went to suppress them.
In the twenty-first year Muslim rebels stirred in the Yellow and Huang river region; Shihan went to suppress them.
河湟 is the Yellow River and Huangshui region, not Huang and Tao.
In the twenty-first year the Muslim rebels of the Huang and Tao rivers stirred; Shihan went to suppress them.
In the twenty-first year the Muslim rebels of the Yellow and Huang rivers stirred; Shihan went to suppress them.
河湟 is the Yellow River and Huangshui, not Huang and Tao.
At Xining he learned that Pingyi post had been besieged for a long time and entered in haste.
At Xining he learned that Pingrong post had been besieged for a long time and entered in haste.
平戎驛 is Pingrong post; Pingyi is a misreading.
Stopping at Xining he heard Pingyi post had long been besieged and entered in haste.
Stopping at Xining he heard Pingrong post had long been besieged and entered in haste.
平戎驛 is Pingrong post; Pingyi is a misreading.
He soon fell ill and died in camp.
His wounds soon reopened and he died in camp.
創發 means his wounds reopened, not that he fell ill.
Soon he fell ill and died in the army.
Soon his wounds reopened and he died in the army.
創發 means his wounds reopened, not that he fell ill.
Governor Zhou Fu memorialized his achievements, and a memorial temple was authorized in his home district.
Governor-general Zhou Fu memorialized his achievements, and a memorial temple was authorized in his home district.
總督 is governor-general, not governor.
Governor Zhou Fu reported his achievements upward and a temple was authorized in his home district.
Governor-general Zhou Fu reported his achievements upward and a temple was authorized in his home district.
總督 is governor-general, not governor.
When Guofan was besieged at Qimen, Fuzhen held Jungen Ridge.
When Guofan was besieged at Qimen, Fuzhen held Jugen Ridge.
櫸根嶺 reads Jugen; 櫸 is jǔ.
When Guofan was hard pressed at Qimen, Fuzhen held Jungen Ridge at Qimen.
When Guofan was hard pressed at Qimen, Fuzhen held Jugen Ridge at Qimen.
櫸根嶺 reads Jugen; 櫸 is jǔ.
Soon the Nian chieftain Ge Xiaonian led nearly ten thousand men in desperate fighting. The siege of Mengcheng tightened. Wenbing and Ying Han attacked from inside and out and won a great victory.

Soon the Nian chieftain Ge Xiaonian led a host of several tens of thousands in desperate fighting. The siege of Mengcheng tightened. Wenbing and Ying Han attacked from inside and out and won a great victory.
可數万 means some several tens of thousands, not nearly ten thousand.
Wenbing joined the various armies in capturing Xiaonian and others, who were executed in pairs, and north Anhui began to grow somewhat calm.
Wenbing joined the various armies in capturing Xiaonian and others, who were executed together, and north Anhui began to grow somewhat calm.
駢僇 means executed together with others.
An excellent edict granted generous mourning favors, ordered temples built in his home district and provinces where he had won merit, and posthumous title Zhuangqin.
A gracious edict granted generous mourning favors, ordered temples built in his home district and provinces where he had won merit, and posthumous title Zhuangqin.
優詔 is a gracious edict; excellent mistranslates 優.
Governor Huang Zonghan memorialized him as foremost in courage and strategy. He was ranked company commander and granted the title Zhanyong Batulu.
Governor-general Huang Zonghan memorialized him as foremost in courage and strategy. He was ranked company commander and granted the title Zhanyong Batulu.
總督 is governor-general, not governor.
Governor Huang Zonghan memorialized recommending him as foremost in stratagem and courage; he was ranked company commander and granted the title Zhanyong Batulu.
Governor-general Huang Zonghan memorialized recommending him as foremost in stratagem and courage; he was ranked company commander and granted the title Zhanyong Batulu.
總督 is governor-general, not governor.
Governor Lao Chongguang relied on him to break the rebels and sent him to aid Jiangxi, capturing Anyuan and Pingyuan in succession.
Governor-general Lao Chongguang relied on him to break the rebels and sent him to aid Jiangxi, capturing Anyuan and Pingyuan in succession.
總督 is governor-general, not governor.
Governor Lao Chongguang relied on him to break bandits and ordered him to aid Gan, in succession taking Anyuan and Pingyuan.
Governor-general Lao Chongguang relied on him to break bandits and ordered him to aid Gan, in succession taking Anyuan and Pingyuan.
總督 is governor-general, not governor.
The false Xingwang Chen Jingang had seized Xinyi and repeatedly threatened Gaozhou.
The false Prince Xing, Chen Jingang, had seized Xinyi and repeatedly threatened Gaozhou.
偽興王 is the title Prince Xing; Xingwang is not part of his name.
At the time the false Xingwang Chen Jingang had taken Xinyi and repeatedly invaded Gaozhou.
At the time the false Prince Xing, Chen Jingang, had taken Xinyi and repeatedly invaded Gaozhou.
偽興王 is the title Prince Xing; Xingwang is not part of his name.
two hundred training ships were reorganized as a mobile reserve.
two hundred war vessels were reorganized as a mobile reserve.
師船 means naval war vessels, not training ships.
two hundred training ships were reorganized as raiding forces for contingency response.
two hundred war vessels were reorganized as raiding forces for contingency response.
師船 means naval war vessels, not training ships.
Because the old guns on the training ships lacked range, he worked with the river provinces to obtain quick-firing artillery, increased pay, and expanded the force until its prestige was restored.
Because the old guns on the war vessels lacked range, he worked with the river provinces to obtain quick-firing artillery, increased pay, and expanded the force until its prestige was restored.
師船 means naval war vessels, not training ships.

Because the training ships' old cannon could not strike at distance, with provinces along the river he planned to exchange for quick-firing guns, increased pay and strengthened troops, and military prestige began to flourish.

Because the war vessels' old cannon could not strike at distance, with provinces along the river he planned to exchange for quick-firing guns, increased pay and strengthened troops, and military prestige began to flourish.
師船 means naval war vessels, not training ships.
In the fourth year the false Kangwang Wang Haiyang fled to Dapu. Yao returned to block him, met the false Shiwang Li Shixian, and fought for three days and nights against odds, routing the enemy.

In the fourth year the false Prince Kang, Wang Haiyang, fled to Dapu. Yao returned to block him, met the false Prince Shi, Li Shixian,, and fought for three days and nights against odds, routing the enemy.
偽康王 is the title Prince Kang; Kangwang is not part of the name. 偽侍王 is the title Prince Shi; Shiwang is not part of the name.

In the fourth year the false Kangwang Wang Haiyang fled to Dapu; Yao returned his army to hold the line, met the false Shiwang Li Shixian, fought in bloody battle three days and nights, with few struck many, and won a great defeat.

In the fourth year the false Prince Kang, Wang Haiyang, fled to Dapu; Yao returned his army to hold the line, met the false Prince Shi, Li Shixian,, fought in bloody battle three days and nights, with few struck many, and won a great defeat.
偽康王 is the title Prince Kang; Kangwang is not part of the name. 偽侍王 is the title Prince Shi; Shiwang is not part of the name.
Governor Ruilin memorialized his achievements and he was awarded a yellow riding jacket.
Governor-general Ruilin memorialized his achievements and he was awarded a yellow riding jacket.
總督 is governor-general, not governor.
Governor Ruilin reported his achievements upward and he was rewarded with a yellow jacket.
Governor-general Ruilin reported his achievements upward and he was rewarded with a yellow jacket.
總督 is governor-general, not governor.
Joining Shaozhong he entered Fujian and captured Pinghe, Zhao'an, Changle, and Zhenping, though rebels still massed at Pinghe in strength.
Joining Shaozhong he entered Fujian and captured Pinghe, Zhao'an, Changle, and Zhenping, though rebels still massed at Heping in strength.
和平 here is Heping county, distinct from 平和 Pinghe.
Again joining Shaozhong's army he entered Fujian and in succession took Pinghe, Zhao'an, Changle, and Zhenping, while remaining bandits gathered at Pinghe still had strong force.
Again joining Shaozhong's army he entered Fujian and in succession took Pinghe, Zhao'an, Changle, and Zhenping, while remaining bandits gathered at Heping still had strong force.
和平 here is Heping county, distinct from 平和 Pinghe.
He campaigned in succession against Zhaoqing, Xiping, and other bandits and was granted the title Ganyong Batulu.
He campaigned in succession against Zhaoqing, Siping, and other bandits and was granted the title Ganyong Batulu.
思平 reads Siping; 思 is si.
In succession he campaigned against Zhaoqing, Xiping, and other bandits and was granted the title Ganyong Batulu.
In succession he campaigned against Zhaoqing, Siping, and other bandits and was granted the title Ganyong Batulu.
思平 reads Siping; 思 is si.
Yao was agile as a cat and crossed mountain trails as if on level ground. His eyes had an uncanny gleam, and he never missed a night shot. Every bandit in Guangdong feared him.
Yao was nimble and crossed mountain trails as if on level ground. His eyes had an uncanny gleam, and he never missed a night shot. Every bandit in Guangdong feared him.
身矯捷 means nimble; the cat simile is not in the source.
